essence: Untired fancy-teeming one, seamless, lords it unborn.
Lore-lamp licking birth-greased wont-wick: when presence?
'Blest, quits, big am I' grounded fancy stands by you.
Self-doer of luck and muck; love mothers luck only.
Step in or self-clear? Man dangles; oversight alone decides.
Supervision-only grace is fulfilment, farthest seat.
Word, wit, work, frame gleam with love alone.
Praise-gem heavy with longings wrought by Nārāyaṇa for Śambhu.

sections.SUMMARY: Wait on Sarva and sweeten hourly new. Unflagging fancy-hatcher stays simplex sovereign sans birth. When burns the wont-wick down to meeting? Blink once clean and command all. Gay vaunts of done-ness stand if thou prop. Thou turnest both wheels; thy love wheels only fair. Dangle between in-step and self-shine till sole survey settles it: mind's smile is siddhi, remotest room. Lip, brain, brawn, bulk gild with thee-love only. Longing-laden laud-gem Nārāyaṇa nailed for the Gracious.

rasa.justification: Ever-new, unwasting, only, remotest: closing gathers all prior hungers into one ornament.
